assumptions.value: 1,000,000 m3/year gross use: 840,000 new freshwater plus 200,000 internally reclaimed water; not an awarded abstraction right. 40,000 m3/year upstream distribution loss; 800,000 fresh reaches uses.
assumptions.basis: No supplied water right or supply design. Reuse is an internal transfer. Construction requires lawful reliable fresh supply.

assumptions.value: 600,000 m3/year of agriculture envelope provisionally reserved for existing pilot; owner metering must replace this before operation. No fixed arrays, plants or grazing arrangements changed.
assumptions.basis: Existing use is unmetered here. Higher verified demand reduces new discretionary uses first; existing operations remain unchanged.

assumptions.value: 2,400 residents at 160 L/person/day = 140,160 m3/year; new irrigation 170,000 m3/year; panel washing 8,263.2 m3/year. Total agriculture including pilot 778,263.2 m3/year.
assumptions.basis: Assumed rates, not local measurements. New irrigation is capped at 30 ha plus nursery; reserved farmland is not all irrigated.

assumptions.value: Average IT 9 MW (12 MW for 12 hours, 6 MW for 12 hours); annual IT 78,840 MWh. PUE 1.25; site WUE 0.02 L/kWh; annual compute water 1,576.8 m3.
assumptions.basis: Closed-loop chip cooling with dry heat rejection and air-cooled mechanical trim; WUE includes makeup and facility uses, no evaporative tower. Performance targets require supplier confirmation at 44 C.

assumptions.value: 40 MW PV; synthetic annual capacity factor 25%; 480 MWh battery, 75 MW converter, 95% efficiency each direction; 216 MWh delivered reserve held for 72 hours at 3 MW critical load. Grid import capacity assumed 30 MW; no export.
assumptions.basis: Illustrative 8760-hour sinusoidal profile, 22% seasonal variation and three dust days each 60 days. No site weather series, tariff or connection offer supplied. tools/energy.py is reproducible, not validated forecasting.

assumptions.value: 200,000 m3/year treated reuse: 100,000 domestic return + 50,000 industrial return + 50,000 captured agricultural drainage; dispatched 180,000 agriculture and 20,000 landscape. Of annual 840,000 fresh input, 40,000 is distribution loss and 800,000 terminal consumption/losses.
assumptions.basis: Assumed recoverable returns require treatment, disinfection and salinity checks. No rain or condensate yield credited. Concentrates require contained handling and licensed removal.

assumptions.value: From 1,000,000 to 700,000 m3/year: landscape 20,000 cut; new irrigation and washing 178,263.2 cut; industry 40,000 cut; domestic/community nonessential use 61,736.8 cut. Existing pilot 600,000 and compute makeup 1,576.8 protected.
assumptions.basis: Gross-use shortage specified by brief, distinct from fresh-water shortage. Domestic/community residual is 78,423.2 m3/year (89.52 L/person/day including communal uses), an emergency assumption requiring verified essential-use sufficiency; if insufficient, secure emergency import or defer occupancy rather than deprive essential use.

assumptions.value: Existing permanent buildings retain conservative exclusion of mapped flood band plus 30 m and channels plus 150 m. Whole-site flood-sensitive screening is shown separately from mountain/flow corridors; it is not a confirmed legal no-build boundary.
assumptions.basis: Screening offsets, not hydraulic standards. Minor washes and external inflows are missing; ground survey and 2D modelling required.

assumptions.value: One to three storeys; regular reinforced concrete frames and ductile walls, braced light roofs; conceptual separation gaps 100 mm minimum subject to drift calculation; design reference INPRES-CIRSOC 103 Part I 2018 with applicable addenda to be confirmed by local engineer.
assumptions.basis: No soil class, spectra or geotechnical report supplied. Geometry is urban design, not structural certification.

assumptions.value: Retire the arbitrary 80 km external road allowance. Regional RN40 approach shown as unverified directional context; internal candidate corridors are measured in the V3 GeoJSON. Actual external route, easements and cost remain phase-one prerequisites.
assumptions.basis: Actual route, easements and crossings unresolved. The nearest-site distance is not the settlement access length. Phase one requires funded access.

assumptions.value: Shade share counts actual proposed roof coverage; thermal comfort requires testing. 2200 K shielded night lighting; no facade uplighting; 10 lux route design target subject to engineering.
assumptions.basis: No outdoor comfort simulation or illuminance survey available. Enclosed cooled refuges are required at 44 C; shade is not a guarantee of safe conditions.

assumptions.value: 960 dwellings; 2.5 persons per dwelling = 2,400 residents; 1,200 local jobs. 1,080 resident workers, 120 inbound specialists; 120 resident remote workers, 600 children/students, 300 retired adults, 300 unpaid carers or job-seekers.
assumptions.basis: Programme targets, not labour-market estimates. Resident categories sum to 2,400; remote-worker income, pensions and household transfers support nonlocal-job households.

assumptions.value: Drying cooperative accepts annual 3,942 MWh usable heat, equal to 5% of IT electricity, via a metered insulated loop and temperature-lift heat pump if required.
assumptions.basis: Declared contracted-use target; herb drying and process wash-water preheat are named receivers, not assumed continuous demand. Reject all unused heat to air; no winter greenhouse demand invented.

assumptions.value: Four conditional town reservations A/B/C/D plus the fixed first living quarter; only the detailed first neighbourhood has 960 proposed dwellings / 2400 residents. No 7200-person whole-site ceiling or final regional population is asserted.
assumptions.basis: A deliberately modest ceiling, not a population forecast. Reservations confer no development entitlement.

assumptions.value: Infrastructure escrow and 12 months public-service operating reserve precede dwelling occupation; compute concession pays annual fixed community service charge independent of runtime.
assumptions.basis: No prices or financing terms supplied; these are proposed enforceable contract conditions, not existing agreements.

assumptions.value: 300m block-mean DEM; mountain/steep screen slope >=5% or elevation >=850m; channel research corridor 150m each side; four towns and two compute reservations clipped by conservative flood and terrain screens.
assumptions.basis: Regional design choices, not statutory restrictions; the source flood band is a sensitivity screen. Eastern gateway strict-screen candidate about 2.64 km2 remains below the brief's about 7km2 intent. Regional capacity, fixed living-quarter demand, water sources, road engineering and resources remain unverified.
